scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @munchkin/server" "npm run dev -w @munchkin/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @munchkin/shared && concurrently "npm run build -w @munchkin/server" "npm run build -w @munchkin/client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @munchkin/server && npm run lint -w @munchkin/client
